'''Jaren Beniko''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who lived on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was married to [[Kelsa Beniko]] and the two had a daughter named [[Lana Beniko|Lana]],<ref name="Jaren" /> who was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and was sent to study the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] by the laws of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Final Trial">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20150306|text="The Final Trial"|int=The Final Trial}}</ref> She eventually reached great heights in the Empire, becoming the Minister of [[Sith Intelligence]].<ref name="The Enemy Within">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=faction|Republic|The Enemy Within|Yavin 4}}</ref> By [[3630 BBY]] both Jaren and Kelsa were listed in records as deceased.<ref name="Jaren" />
